# Evidence contract

Run the locked Semantic SDK resolver and offline check, use emitted facts and locked Skia; do not rebuild dependencies. Reconstruct a local Windows native build, record complete commands, process exits, compiler and source/package hashes. Discover exact test IDs before executing with `ctest --tests-from-file <absolute names> --no-tests=error --output-on-failure --output-junit <path>`; reject missing, extra, skipped or zero tests. Run all old 14 D07 IDs and their revised positive/negative bindings, the blocking OOM executables and all exact 160 Selection IDs. Retain original evidence without mutation.

Execute each SCENE-PREP-01..06 as a distinguishable real-owner case and capture observations, fault injection phase, before/after document, revision/generation, records, selection query/hit/draw, invalidation, observer counts, History cursor and redo. Exercise real record store, render, spatial and damage participants; an aggregate test with no individual case evidence or test-only fake preparer does not pass. Record operation IDs, stamps, ChangeSets, and ordered real bridge callbacks. Test stale bases, abort, failure at every actual allocation/reservation boundary, post-success no-allocation publication and compatible single-op paths. Test Undo/Redo with fresh IDs, reentrancy and changed selection.

Run actual Chrome/WASM where locked toolchain supports it; report unavailable environments and synthetic input honestly. Run ABI manifest and source scope diff. Classify genuine blockers: AUTHORITY_CONFLICT, MISSING_REQUIRED_INPUT, ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKER, FROZEN_VERIFICATION_FAILURE, NEW_HIGH_IMPACT_FAILURE_MODE, TASK_PACKAGE_DEFECT or EXECUTION_DIVERGENCE. No test reported as product PASS before actual execution.
